summary: Frontend-only smoke and interaction test of AdminKit static phase (Laravel+Inertia+Vue). All requested flows work: 5 KPI cards render, sidebar Umum group with active Dashboard item, area switcher (Member/Admin with empty-note), user menu (Profil/Keluar) navigates to /profile and updates breadcrumb, sidebar collapse toggle changes data-state expanded->collapsed, theme toggle sets 'dark' class and persists across reload, notifications popover shows notification-1, /login form works with password-visibility toggle and submit redirects to dashboard, /profile shows Foto Profil / Informasi Akun / Kata Sandi cards with Simpan & Batal buttons. No console errors or page errors detected in light or dark mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Phase 1 fully validated via Playwright against public preview URL. Sidebar renders via shadcn wrapper (no <aside>); use [data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"] with data-state attribute to detect expanded/collapsed. Assets are Vite-built; Vue file edits won't hot reload.
